proposal_title: Complete 15-Repository Acyclic Dependency DAG & Forbidden Matrix
domain_specific_rationale: As Platform Specialist, maintaining a strictly acyclic dependency graph across the 15 polyrepo services is vital for CI/CD parallelization, modular builds, container containerization, and blast-radius containment. The prior specification lacked explicit cross-cutting layer definitions for R14 (Platform Observability) and R15 (Integration Harness), leading to ambiguous import boundaries and potential circular references. CP-010 establishes a clear 6-tier architectural layering model (Layer 0 Contracts through Layer 5 Workflow/Console) along with an explicit Allowed vs Forbidden matrix for every repository. It codifies platform-level invariants prohibiting direct database access from peripheral services, enforcing FlowExecutionPort isolation, and mathematically proving that the dependency graph is 100% acyclic.
evidence_citations: 04_integration/DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.md:L7-L22 (Architectural Layers Layer 0 to Layer 5 + Cross-Cutting R14/R15)
04_integration/DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.md:L46-L50 (Architectural invariants: Acyclic DAG, Database Encapsulation, Port Isolation)

capability_impact: Enforces polyrepo architectural boundaries and independent deployability across all 15 repositories, securing CAP-04, CAP-14, and platform build isolation.
residual_risk: Implementation agents might introduce indirect transitively bundled libraries that violate layer boundaries. Mitigated by CI static dependency analysis and import linters configured against DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.md.
